summary: Axonex AI Group Ltd, a BVI-incorporated foreign private issuer, filed a 6-K reporting that its board adopted unanimous written resolutions on November 3, 2026, amending its authorized share capital from 112,000,000 no-par shares (100,800,000 Class A and 11,200,000 Class B) to an unlimited number of no-par Class A and Class B shares. The Sixth Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles was filed with the BVI Registrar and became effective November 4, 2026. No price, stake, premium, advisor or board recommendation is stated. The change is charter housekeeping enabling future issuance; watch for dilution or capital-raise follow-through rather than deal mechanics.
